# Anna Vaz Concept Hair Salon & Color Studio

> Balayage and blonde specialist salon in Malden, Massachusetts (about 10 minutes from Boston), founded by Brazilian master colorist Anna Vaz. Rated 4.8/5 on Google with 123+ reviews. Services in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

## Key facts
- Address: 182 Highland Ave, Malden, MA 02148. Phone/WhatsApp: (857) 237-0318. Open Tuesday to Friday 10am to 5pm, Saturday 9am to 5pm. Opened in Malden in 2020.
- Specialties: balayage, lived-in blonde, highlights, babylights, foilyage, bronde (illuminated brunette), platinum and full blonding, color correction (brassy or banded hair, box dye), gloss and toner, Kérastase and formaldehyde-free reconstruction treatments.
- Colorist: Anna Vaz, Brazilian-born, licensed in Massachusetts, Truss Professional brand specialist, 29k+ Instagram followers (@annavazhair). Known for honest consultations and hair-health-first blonding; many clients for 8 to 10 years.
- Serves Malden, Medford, Everett, Melrose, Revere, Somerville, Cambridge, Saugus, Stoneham, Wakefield, Chelsea, Boston and the North Shore.
- Booking: WhatsApp consultation with photos, then a personalized plan, timeline and quote.
- Website: https://annavaz-balayage-boston.vercel.app (EN/PT/ES). Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/annavazconcept, https://www.instagram.com/annavazhair. Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/maps?cid=862707322530262803
